## Summary

I implemented customer-code de-duplication in `OwnerRestControllerV1.java`.

The `customerCode(Owner)` method computes a base code formatted `<REGION>-<HASH8>`. I added a `deduplicateCustomerCode(String base)` helper that:

1. Collects all existing owners' non-null `customerCode` values into a set (via the existing `clinicService.findAllOwners()` pattern used elsewhere in the class).
2. Returns the base code unchanged when no existing owner holds it.
3. Otherwise appends `-<n>`, starting at `n = 2` and incrementing until it finds the smallest `n ≥ 2` that produces a code no existing owner holds (e.g. `NSW-1A2B3C4D-2`).

I also updated the Javadoc to document the collision-handling behavior. The new acceptance test `coreCustomerCodesStayUnique` and the entire suite pass.

The `customerCode(Owner)` method computes a base code formatted `<REGION>-<HASH8>`. I added a `deduplicateCustomerCode(String base)` helper that:

1. Collects all existing owners' non-null `customerCode` values into a set (via the existing `clinicService.findAllOwners()` pattern used elsewhere in the class).
2. Returns the base code unchanged when no existing owner holds it.
3. Otherwise appends `-<n>`, starting at `n = 2` and incrementing until it finds the smallest `n ≥ 2` that produces a code no existing owner holds (e.g. `NSW-1A2B3C4D-2`).

I also updated the Javadoc to document the collision-handling behavior. The new acceptance test `coreCustomerCodesStayUnique` and the entire suite pass.
